title: Excellent work, uncertain understanding
lines: The report is excellent, but its author cannot explain how the conclusion was reached.
The Great Decoupling examines a widening separation between impressive output and the understanding once assumed behind it.

emotionalPlan.purpose: Understand how AI changes the relationship among performance, learning and responsibility.
emotionalPlan.visualActing: Keep polished output visibly separate from the learner's incomplete explanation.
voiceDirections: Open with engaged, conversational curiosity; let the concrete situation carry the hook, with no ominous trailer voice.
Clear, interested and measured; emphasize the specific human stake, with no theatrical suspense.

title: The artifact and its maker
lines: Generative AI gives more people access to capable performance, opening doors previously closed by expertise or resources.
At the same time, a polished artifact becomes weaker evidence of what its maker actually knows.

title: What practice leaves behind
lines: The book follows that change through work, education, culture, and the institutions that distribute responsibility.
Its central tension concerns what we gain through assistance and what practice quietly teaches us along the way.

title: Who can explain the result?
lines: For anyone learning or working with AI, the question reaches beyond whether a tool saves time.
Begin with the finished report, and ask who could defend it when its assumptions fail.
